decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's consumer health knowledge and pharmacy channels, so the firm can read market feedback and refine the line rather than withdraw it.
The skin and hair supplement sits close to the established supplement brand, and the firm can absorb early results from pharmacy sales to keep improving it.
The mushroom immune supplement is a niche with low visibility, but it still falls within the firm's supplement expertise, and immune products gained demand after 2020, so keeping it is reasonable.

Although the valsartan generic is distant from the core and was hit by the recall, the firm already has generics manufacturing, quality-control and regulatory capabilities, and it kept the product through the crisis, so continuing it within the broad generics range is likely.

The OTC triptan rests on the firm's strong pharmaceutical development, regulatory and pharmacy-channel knowledge, which lets it assimilate the results of a 2019 launch, so it will be kept despite gaps in website evidence.
